x: Ted Gaworski put the weight 43' 2" and the discus 135' 5" being 2nd in each event, whilst Percy Luxon won the Triple Jump with 45' 7" and the Long Jump with 20' 7". R. Harris finished 3rd in the weight with 41' 10".
Not in the records, but scoring valuable points, were Discus - R.Harris, 121ft.10ins, third. Shot put - R.

In this, the last track match of the season, the outstanding feature was the absence of track men, despite which, with the aid of the field events men, who scored 23 points out of our total of 32, we won the trophy from Walton A.C. by one point. R.
We cannot keep our Field Events men out of the picture these days and they were busy putting the weight. R.Harris (scratch) won with a very good out of season putt of 44ft. 3ins.
A few days later R. Harris again put the shot 47ft. 3inches when representing A.A.A. v Oxford University and we look forward to even better efforts later in the year.
